svg.title: Rilova — Luminous Tide. Three original interface concepts.
svg.desc: A static concept board for Today, Progress and Make Room. All activity and chart data are illustrative. These proposals are not implemented and do not show a functioning app.

g.font-family: SF Pro Display, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Expressive colour. Clear actions. Progress grounded in what you actually record.
Equal weight per habit · Skips and pauses excluded
Distinct habits checked in, by day
Empty days mean no record. They aren’t failure.
Timer time and habit success stay separate.
A week in view. Clear Log controls.
One compact header, then your habits.
Real periods, legible charts and honest gaps.
Illustrative data, with records distinct from absence.
Optional settings stay explicit and close to the action.
STATIC VISUAL PROPOSAL · NOT A FUNCTIONAL PROTOTYPE · NO APP CODE CHANGED
Luminous Tide · Mint / ivory / deep teal
